verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI runs on CPU ('No GPU required', 'Every feature ships a CPU path first') and auto-detects GPU capabilities. Nothing in the pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX, or any instruction-set-specific builds or detection. Generic CPU support is adjacent and does not show the product exploits these instruction sets for faster inference.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
